errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted in alphabetical order. The order shown is "Готови продукти" (starts with Г), "Полуготови продукти" (П), "Суровини и материали" (С), and "Резервни части и консумативи" (Р). Alphabetical order in Cyrillic would be Г, П, Р, С. The chart presents them in the order Г, П, С, Р.
The phrase "извънредно ясно" (exceptionally clear) is subjective and evaluative language that should be avoided in a factual description.
